external.description: Apple's first foldable iPhone is impressive for a first-generation product, but at $2,000, every compromise matters. Here's what stands out and what doesn't.

At a recent event, Apple announced the rumored foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo. Unlike vertical flip phones like Motorola, it opens horizontally like a book, resembling a passport in size and folding style. Entering a competitive market dominated by Samsung and Google, Apple's entry is expected to further evolve foldable device design. It features a very compact body, making it the thinnest iPhone ever when open. Inside, it boasts a 7.6-inch display, with a 5.4-inch display on the outside, available in Star White and Night Sky. The crease, a common issue in previous foldable devices, has been reduced to a nearly imperceptible level. However, future attention remains on whether the crease will become more prominent over time due to wear and tear, similar to other companies' devices.
